description: This file defines the CrosvmBuilder class, which provides an interface for constructing and configuring a command to run the Crosvm virtual machine monitor. It includes methods for adding CPUs, disks, serial consoles, vhost-user devices, and other VM configurations, as well as managing the command execution.

classes.name: CrosvmBuilder
classes.description: A class for building and configuring the command line invocation of Crosvm, a virtual machine monitor.

methods.name: ApplyProcessRestarter
methods.description: Configures the builder to restart the process with specified binary, argument, and exit code.

methods.name: AddControlSocket
methods.description: Adds a control socket to the VM configuration.

methods.name: AddCpus
methods.description: Adds CPU configuration, either by count and frequency file or via JSON.

methods.name: AddHvcReadOnly
methods.description: Adds a read-only HVC device with optional console flag.

methods.name: AddHvcReadWrite
methods.description: Adds an HVC device with read/write access.

methods.name: AddKvmPath
methods.description: Specifies the path to the KVM device.

methods.name: AddSerialConsoleReadWrite
methods.description: Adds a serial console with read/write access.

methods.name: AddVhostUser
methods.description: Adds a vhost-user device with specified type, socket, and queue size.

methods.name: HvcNum
methods.description: Returns the number of HVC devices.

methods.name: Cmd
methods.description: Returns a reference to the command object being built.
